tested_combinations.detail: All 8 themes on window-01 × thread-c01 at 750 px (frames theme-*). Retro swaps type + zero radius; Glass uses opaque plate sheens; light/dark contrast inspected.
520/750/975/1200 px on window-05 × thread-c04 with pinned history + open artifact (frames width-*). Floor verified numerically at 520 (chat = 520 px, history degraded to compact).
All 8 windows with diagonal thread, pinned-full history + open artifact at 975 px, alternating basic-dark/glass-dark (frames window-sweep-*).
All 8 thread concepts at 520 px in window-06 with the two-questionnaire thread (thread-12) plus goal + ten-state todos, friendly-light (frames thread-narrow-*).

Long/virtualized thread (retro-dark), goal blocked (basic-light), BSD evaluating + route warning (glass-dark), offline with queued draft + BSD Off (friendly-dark), reduced-motion questionnaire (basic-dark), pop-out (friendly-dark), ordinary wide (retro-light 1200), blocked audit under Review-limited Full Access (glass-light) (frames state-*).
Side panel open in all frames; toggled closed interactively during pressure checks (width evaluation reruns via ResizeObserver).
state-popout frame + probe-verified state preservation both directions.
state-reduced-motion-question frame; every continuous motion has a static twin (glow→halo, orbit→ring, cursor/caret→dimmed, breath→solid); global gate collapses transitions to final states.
Slider drags at 1-px steps exercised interactively; Periscope's 980 px crystallization is a property switch with no animation scrubbing; no overflow at any sampled width.
Draft + questionnaire + route state survive reload; replay idempotency probed twice.

untested_combinations: Full 8-theme sweep on every one of the 64 pairings (8×64×4 widths = 2048 cells): sampled representatively instead; token/theme usage is shared, so per-pairing theme risk is limited to layout, which the pairing matrix covers at default theme.
RTL locales, browser zoom levels, and non-1440 desktop viewports.
Reduced-motion captures for every motion-bearing interaction (verified by code-path gate + one representative capture).
direct_inspection_findings_resolved: Jump-to-latest chip could overlap questionnaire navigation after late layout shifts → env-change anchor restore added; chip now hides at bottom.
Bindery running-head center title could crowd the right controls → capped at 42% with ellipsis.
Selector row clipped at 750 px → wraps with row gap.
Chat floor arithmetic under-counted open-bench width → per-window pressure values corrected (440–480 px).
Shared header chrome lived in window-01.css only → moved to components.css (was breaking W3 title ellipsis).
Code artifact line grid had stray newline rows → joined without separators.
Search query text was lost on dock/pop-out remount → input restores from stored search state.
Search jump into a collapsed message left the matching region hidden → jump expands the message first.
Thread rename used a native prompt dialog → replaced with an in-place popup-family stage.
More Info lacked the account/connection field → Account row added when the thread route's provider matches.
